GDPR Compliance

Your rights under the EU General Data Protection Regulation.

AmerCloud processes personal data on behalf of customers who may be located in the European Union. We act as a data processor; you are the controller of the data you deploy on our platform.

Your rights as a data subject

  • Right of access to your personal data
  • Right to rectification and erasure
  • Right to data portability (machine-readable export)
  • Right to restrict or object to processing
  • Right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority

Data Processing Agreement

A signed DPA is available on request for any paid plan. Email nova-cloud-2026@outlook.com.

Sub-processors

  • Stripe (payments — global)
  • Fawry & InstaPay (payments — Egypt)
  • Microsoft 365 (transactional email)
  • Cloudflare (DNS & DDoS protection)

To exercise any GDPR right, email nova-cloud-2026@outlook.com. We respond within 30 days.
